response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's claim that "The system is rigged" and its call to "Wake up" echo the anti-establishment, election-integrity framing of T4-004732, which alleges "Massive Voter Fraud" via a Florida election worker [T4-004732](#T4-004732), and the "#WakeUpAmerica" warning against "tricks" in T4-004421 [T4-004421](#T4-004421). The new post also shares a broader distrust-of-institutions tone with T4-009173, which alleges "corruption in our justice system" [T4-009173](#T4-009173). However, the new post is a generic, hashtag-driven call to action ("Share to expose the truth. #StopTheSteal") with no specific allegation, source, or link, whereas T4-004732 cites a named role and video and T4-009173 targets specific media figures [T4-004732](#T4-004732) [T4-009173](#T4-009173). T4-003068 (a direct accusation of lying against a named politician) and T4-003396 (prison-abolition solidarity) address different targets and share no meaningful overlap with the new post's election-fraud framing [T4-003068](#T4-003068) [T4-003396](#T4-003396).
